title: Descobrir v1 GraphIndex
description: Canonical index of Knowledge Record and Relation IDs produced by one Descobrir load. Lists are sorted lexicographically for deterministic comparison. canonical_graph_hash is SHA-256 over the canonicalized complete structured Records and Relations of the load (including evidence and status; excluding narrative/observational metadata such as free-form prose outside the structural contract, timestamps, run ids, and generated_at). Manifest id and raw artifact content hashes MUST NOT substitute for graph content in this hash. Repeatability compares canonical_graph_hash for identical Native Artifact bytes + source_revision. engine and artifact_manifest_id are load linkage metadata, not substitutes for the graph hash payload.

id.description: Identifier of this graph index document for the load. Not an input to canonical_graph_hash.

namespace.description: Knowledge Namespace of the owning project. All listed record and relation IDs are unique within this namespace.

source_revision.description: Pinned logical VCS revision that anchors the indexed load. Repeatability input context (with identical Native Artifact bytes).

artifact_manifest_id.description: Content-addressed Artifact Manifest id for this load (see artifact-manifest.schema.json). Load linkage only — MUST NOT substitute for graph content in canonical_graph_hash.

name.description: Discovery Engine name as a generic non-empty string. Load linkage metadata.

profile.description: Engine profile as a generic non-empty string. Load linkage metadata.

engine.description: Engine identity for the load. Not a substitute for canonical_graph_hash content. Re-running the Discovery Engine is not part of the v1 repeatability gate.

record_ids.description: Canonical Knowledge Record IDs, sorted lexicographically ascending. Sort order is part of the contract. Navigation aid; the hash covers full structured records, not only IDs.

relation_ids.description: Canonical Relation IDs (type-prefixed), sorted lexicographically ascending. Sort order is part of the contract. Navigation aid; the hash covers full structured relations, not only IDs.

canonical_graph_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical projection of the complete structured set of Knowledge Records and Relations for this load. INCLUDED for records: id, namespace, type, name, attributes, status, source_revision, source_engine and full evidence. INCLUDED for relations: id, namespace, from_record, relation_type, to_record, status, source_revision, source_engine and full evidence. EXCLUDED: the record summary (narrative projection), CoverageReport timestamps, GraphIndex.metadata, free-form logs, wall-clock fields, producer_run_id, generated_at and any field marked metadata-only. Objects use stable key ordering and set-like arrays use deterministic ordering defined by the adapter profile. MUST NOT be computed from manifest id alone or from raw Native Artifact content hashes alone — those do not substitute for graph content. Repeatability.result compares this hash across two Adapter index runs on identical Native Artifact bytes + source_revision.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of index generation. Metadata only; MUST NOT enter canonical_graph_hash.

producer_run_id.description: Optional run correlation id. Metadata only; MUST NOT enter canonical_graph_hash.

metadata.description: Observational metadata excluded from canonical_graph_hash semantics.

canonicalRelationId.description: Type-prefixed Canonical Relation ID derived from relation_type + from_record + to_record.
